column1: # SemR's constant fragment: the Rust `Constant` variants whose semantics is
# beside the SemR `Const` constructor that carries it.
# both sides: the Rust variant exists and SemR.lean declares the constructor;
# every Rust `Constant` variant NOT listed here keeps the old gate (a
# SemR `Const` constructor is a row here or names an old-gate variant. A listed
# constant is credited by SemR's differential only when an agreeing run
# EXECUTES it (`semr_eval --executed`'s `consts`). An element type SemR
# refuses by name (`unsupported <feature>`, e.g. a float tensor element, until
# PKG-U15) stays refused; the row is the constant former.
